entities.summary: Darwin Zahedy Saleh was an Indonesian economist. He was part of the Second United Indonesia Cabinet and served as Minister of Energy and Mineral Resources in Indonesia from 22 October 2009 to 19 October 2011. Saleh was a noted academic who was a long-time lecturer at the University of Indonesia and was a financial consultant, manager and banker.
